scope: Actual internal local catalog provenance publication joined to the existing partial entry writer; control finalization and imported-role handoff remain incomplete.
source_assessment: Canonical source project identity and transitive ancestors use the existing bounded canonical readers and DAG check. Local source ref is derived from the actual resolved local root; no Git provenance is invented.

Prospective canonical bytes, actual staged file receipts, original metadata observation and original mode are captured before entry effects. The frozen ticket retains original bytes independently of subsequent live input advancement.

Preparation funds serialization, retained metadata, comparison views and additional journal event/storage allowances before public entry effects. Shared original stage ledger ceilings remain in force.

Actual registry publication progress, rather than mutable inspection output, requires every selected item to be published before provenance. Exact plan acknowledgement, writer membership, active PID/thread/factory/control/journal admissions and single-use phase remain checked.

Original single-link regular metadata is moved exclusively to retained private storage before prospective exclusive publication. Live canonical input advances only from sealed bytes and the verified actual native move; immutable original plan input remains unchanged.

Currentness compares full expected project/private views, actual canonical inputs, original selected sources, protected controls and final native facts. Foreign changes poison the owner and are preserved; ambiguous failures retain old/prospective files and durable intent.
Normal provenance-published context exit still refuses completion pending control finalization and imported-role handoff.

coverage: Absent canonical metadata positive, actual source identity/ref and file hashes, expired writer/context refusal.
Original inode/raw/mode retention and preservation of unrelated imports and inheritance decisions.
Wrong acknowledgement, incomplete actual item publications and forged inspection results refuse.
Single use and later foreign metadata preservation.
Hardlinked original metadata refusal before item effects.
Interrupted post-retirement publication retains original/prospective nodes and durable intent.
Multiple items share timestamp and canonical transitive source ancestors.
Provenance event budget refuses before public entry effect.
Foreign metadata after entry effects prevents provenance publication.

limits: Observed-span consistency only; no continuously frozen snapshot or hostile concurrent-writer guarantee.
No new bespoke fault scripts or predecessor replay. Dynamic evidence is exactly the maintained nine-method module.
No independent broad regression or author affected-suite result claimed by this report.
Internal POSIX/local source-provider profile only; no Git checkout-source provenance lease, public catalog API completion, installed-wheel or cross-platform qualification.
Canonical control finalization, live imported ownership/handoff, fresh recovery and full retained-layout program acceptance remain mandatory.
Saved provenance rows, phase flags and results do not grant imported ownership.
No implementation/test/pin edits, new agents, installs or network actions. Source hashes rechecked unchanged after execution. No independent process remains live.
